name: Personal Library Manager
overview: Beta 2: private lists, visual saved hearts and independent native likes. Linux x64 only.
description: Create private personal collections from your Jellyfin catalog. Integrates native favorites, Watch Later, private list thumbnails, search, genres, pagination and recoverable deletion without deleting original media. Beta: tested on Jellyfin 12.4.0 and Linux x64 only; other hosts and architectures are not validated. The web interface requires Plugin Pages 3.0.3.0 and File Transformation 3.0.3.0, Release-12.4.0 builds. Back up your configuration and PLM data before installing. Interface translations are partial outside English/Portuguese, with English fallback. Optional native playlist mirrors remain experimental.

versions.changelog: Fix saved-heart presentation: native likes and personal lists are independent. Hearts also reflect Watch Later, with private batched lookups. Includes theme and cached-page navigation fixes. Previous beta 1 archives remain immutable.

First public beta. Private lists, native favorites, Watch Later, private thumbnails, recoverable deletion, filters, pagination, theme-aware controls and interface-language preferences. Linux x64; tested on Jellyfin 12.4.0. Requires Plugin Pages and File Transformation 3.0.3.0 Release-12.4.0. Partial translations outside English/Portuguese; English fallback. Back up before installing.

name: What U Need?
overview: Beta 4: improved request navigation, read/unread notifications and decision controls. Linux x64 only.
description: Search the installed TMDb provider, request catalog content and support existing requests. Personal user queues, a general administrator queue, covers, participant context and separate unread/read notifications. Search stays open after requesting; state-aware administrator actions and refresh preserve queue filters. Native configuration and metrics, availability reconciliation, confirmed reopening and optional expiration/retention. All deletion and expiration policies default to disabled. Acquisition is manual. Upgrade migrates the WUN database to schema 3: back up binaries, plugin configuration and WUN data; restore matching binaries and database together to revert. Tested on Jellyfin 12.4.0 / Linux x64 only. User-facing page requires Plugin Pages and File Transformation 3.0.3.0 Release-12.4.0. Portuguese/English with English fallback.

versions.changelog: Improve request navigation and administrator workflow: correct page titles, separate unread/read notifications, full-row media-type selection, keep search after requesting, default the administrator queue to pending approval, reflect saved decisions in available actions and refresh without losing filters.

Personal queues and unique supports, enriched notifications and administrator decisions, native configuration/metrics, automatic availability reconciliation and optional retention. Tested on Jellyfin 12.4.0 / Linux x64. All deletion and expiration policies are disabled by default.

Align the Requests header tooltip with the Jellyfin Search/Profile tooltips. Uses host palette variables, matching typography and spacing, delayed hover and immediate keyboard focus. Preserves accessible labels, supports Escape and removes the browser-native title popup. Handles recreated header buttons and language changes.

First public beta: catalog search, user requests, administrator decisions, private notes, followers and notifications. Movie/series details, season covers, episode stills, availability and provider release dates. Acquisition is manual; automated monitoring workers are not included.
